flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No court XML/PDF generator or upload job. Supporting data: ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/offencerulecode/OffenceRuleCode (complaint_code), ocmsadminui utils/models/Icsdbatch.d.ts (unused type). ocmsadminprivateapi utilities/sftpComponent/{SftpConfig,SftpUtil} are generic with no State Courts server.
note: 8-point story (status_with_ura: Demo paid 50% of 75%; the demo_remark mentions SFTP and SFTP permission for the api App Service server, which is a claim, not repo evidence). After confirm, OCMS must build a case registration XML file, complaint description and charge sheet PDFs and send them to State Courts. In the six repos there is no court XML/PDF generator, no upload job, and no State Courts server in the SFTP config (SftpConfig.java:204-211). Only supporting data remains: the complaint_code column in the offence rule master (OffenceRuleCode.java:42-43) and the TypeScript type Icsdbatch.d.ts (fields filename_xml, filename_chargesheet, filename_complaintletter, upload_sftp), which is not used anywhere. SftpUtil is a generic mechanism for other partners, not code of this story. SFTP connection and State Courts file format: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket. Note: CasIntegrationController (/casUpdateCourtNotices) is the inbound direction from CAS to OCMS, not a file push to State Courts.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The Court Application feature (submission to State Courts) is not in the six repos; only comments, TypeScript types and menu placeholders remain. Ask URA/the team in which repo it was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: After Confirm, OCMS starts building files for the submitted batch
steps.detail: No controller, job or cron is triggered by court application confirm. Synonym searches (court application, court batch, case registration, charge sheet) across the six repos are empty; the cron service has no court submit job.

steps.step: OCMS generates the case registration file in XML format
steps.detail: There is no case registration XML generator in the backend. Only the fields filename_xml and b_lob_xml exist in the TypeScript type Icsdbatch (Icsdbatch.d.ts:9-10), which is not imported anywhere, so it is a data design leftover, not a feature.

steps.step: OCMS generates the complaint description in PDF
steps.detail: There is no PDF generator for court complaint descriptions. Only the complaint_code column in the offence rule master (OffenceRuleCode.java:42-43) and the Complaint Code master page in System Admin (ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/System.ts:111-113) exist; they are input data, not document generation.

steps.step: OCMS generates the charge sheet in PDF
steps.detail: There is no charge sheet PDF generator. Only the fields filename_chargesheet and b_lob_chargesheet in the Icsdbatch type (Icsdbatch.d.ts:11-12) exist and are unused. PdfGeneratorService in ocmseserviceapi is only for payment receipts.

steps.step: OCMS sends (interfaces) the files to State Courts via SFTP
steps.detail: The SFTP server list has no State Courts entry (SftpConfig.java:204-211) and there is no court folder in sftp-common.properties. A generic SftpUtil exists but has no court caller; a generic mechanism that is not this story's is not counted. The SFTP permission mentioned in demo_remark: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The interface result is recorded on the batch/notice so the notices are processed for court application
steps.detail: No code fills the upload status (upload_sftp in Icsdbatch.d.ts:15 is unused) or advances the notice stage after sending to State Courts. The backend entity ocms_court_case only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:21-31) with no batch or interface status column.
